turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm struggling to get this new microservice running. Any tips on debugging?
Hi Alan! Have you checked the logs for any specific error codes? Sometimes the network configuration is the culprit.
Yeah, logs are messy. I tried using an AI agent to fix it, but it just kept generating broken code. I don't trust those tools anymore.
That can be frustrating. Did it hallucinate the dependencies?
Exactly. It's why I'm reading Kyle Mistele's stuff. He argues that most agent loops are 'blind Ralph loops' which produce unreadable code. I need something that actually explains itself.
Understood. So you're prioritizing clarity and maintainability over speed right now.
Yes. Also, do you know if it's going to rain tomorrow? I need to plan my commute.
The forecast shows a high chance of showers in the afternoon. You might want to bring an umbrella.
Thanks. I'll stick to the train then.
